1.0.3: True/False tasks: the Next button now lights up as soon as an answer is selected (both plain true-false and reading true/false), even before pressing Check.

Halloween course fixes in the player: click-on-picture tasks without an image file now render a generated Halloween scene with the hotspots instead of a broken picture; tasks with a direct image source show it via the media pipeline; listen-choice speaks the options aloud when no audio clip is attached.
1.0.2: Fixed the course editor: creating a new course no longer shows a blank screen, and opening an existing textbook for editing no longer crashes with "Failed to execute 'appendChild' on 'Node': parameter 1 is not of type 'Node'".
Editor render errors are now caught and shown as a readable error box with a link back, instead of a silent empty page.
1.0.1: Blinking red beacon on the "🔄 Update" button: it lights up whenever the hub holds new or changed courses since your last sync, and goes dark after you update (tooltip lists the pending courses).
1.0.0: Authoring studio with 30 exercise types: audio, video, text, drag & drop, matching, quizzes and more.
Course hub: publish, edit and delete courses from the shared-hub git branch; one-click "🔄 Update" syncs every teacher's library (deletions propagate too).
Admin panel behind the Konami code for managing hub courses.
One-click in-app self-update: when a new release appears you get a dialog with the changes list and an "Update now" button — no manual file downloads.
The update button is only visible while a newer release actually exists.
